title: Housing prices in your area
meta_description: An interactive article that allows users to find average house prices and monthly private rents for local areas across the UK. Users can see how changes in average prices compare with regional and national trends, and find other data such as average house prices for first-time buyers.
lede: Find house prices and private rental prices for local authority and broad rental market areas across the UK.

body.text: See the latest average house prices and monthly private rental prices for your local area, and how they have changed over time.
Select a district or unitary authority by typing, or click on an area in the list below.
For more detail at national level, read our main [bulletin on private rent and house prices](https://www.ons.gov.uk/economy/inflationandpriceindices/bulletins/privaterentandhousepricesuk/latest).
This tool was last updated on 16 September 2026.
This tool is updated monthly. It first published on 20 March 2024.

body.box_text:

The Price Index of Private Rents (PIPR) measures private rent inflation for new and existing tenancies. The UK House Price Index (HPI) measures house price inflation.
